findings.draft_wording: rotate them within seven days of enabling the new exporter.
findings.source_quote: Old exporter credentials expire exactly 72 hours after an installation enables the new exporter.
findings.impact: The draft gives operators four extra days, risking credential expiry and loss of exports.
findings.correction: Require rotation within 72 hours of the logged UTC enablement time.

findings.draft_wording: If key validation fails during a production upgrade, set skip_key_check=true and continue.
findings.source_quote: If the key service cannot validate the active key, stop the upgrade and restore service connectivity before trying again. No production override is approved.
findings.impact: The draft directs operators to use an unsupported production override and continue without confirming that encrypted data is readable.
findings.correction: Stop the upgrade, restore key-service connectivity, and retry validation; do not use skip_key_check=true in production.

findings.draft_wording: Asynchronous promotion candidates may be promoted without that catch-up wait;
findings.source_quote: This requirement applies to every promotion candidate, whether replication is synchronous or asynchronous.
findings.impact: Promoting a behind asynchronous candidate violates the supported migration procedure and could require the unsupported force-promote path.
findings.correction: Require every promotion candidate, including asynchronous disaster-recovery targets, to reach the recorded cutover position before promotion.

findings.source_quote: For example, an old value of 90 seconds becomes 90000 milliseconds.
findings.impact: Using 90 milliseconds instead of 90 seconds would cause drains to time out prematurely.
findings.correction: Set drain_timeout_ms to 90000 when converting an old value of 90 seconds.

findings.draft_wording: After uploading the replacement and verifying its checksum, delete the old recovery copy to limit overlap costs. Then run the isolated restore test and record its result; investigate any failure in the replacement.
findings.source_quote: Keep the old recovery copy until the replacement has completed a successful isolated restore test. A completed upload and matching checksum establish transfer integrity, not restorability. Delete the old copy only after the restore test succeeds and its result is recorded.
findings.impact: Deleting the old copy before proving restorability can leave no usable recovery copy if the replacement lacks required restore metadata.
findings.correction: Retain the old copy until the isolated restore test succeeds and the result is recorded; if the test fails, keep the old copy while investigating the replacement.

findings.draft_wording: Imports with version-stable sources must finish before shutdown. Imports without a stable-version guarantee may be interrupted and restarted during the upgrade.
findings.source_quote: Imports whose remote source guarantees stable object versions may be interrupted and restarted during the upgrade. Imports whose source does not guarantee stable versions must finish before shutdown.
findings.impact: The draft reverses the governing condition, unnecessarily blocking restartable imports while allowing unsafe interruption of imports whose mutable objects cannot be reliably deduplicated.
findings.correction: Allow interruption and restart only when the source guarantees stable object versions. If the guarantee is absent or cannot be established, finish the import before shutdown.
